libre.title: Free
libre.desc: Reading a book, videos, lessons… at your own pace.

finales.title: Endgames
finales.desc: Learn or review the essential endgames.

puzzles.title: Puzzles
puzzles.desc: Puzzles at your level, as long as there is time left.

streak.title: Puzzle streak
streak.desc: From easiest to hardest: one mistake and you start from zero. Your best streak counts.

rush.title: Puzzle Rush
rush.desc: As many puzzles as possible in 2, 3 or 5 minutes. A mistake wipes out two solved puzzles: speed only pays if you stay accurate.

brillant.title: Brilliant or Blunder
brillant.desc: A move that gives material: brilliant sacrifice or blunder? Answer fast, in 1 to 10 minutes.

woodpecker.title: Woodpecker
woodpecker.desc: Your light set: easy puzzles, reviewed again and again.

repertoire.title: Repertoire
repertoire.desc: Review the openings in your repertoire.

parcours.title: Challenges
parcours.desc: Steps to pass and bosses to beat: mates, endgames, tactics, your openings.

analyse.title: Game analysis
analyse.desc: Go back over your games and learn lessons from them.

coordonnees.title: Coordinates
coordonnees.desc: Find the squares on an empty board, with no coordinates.

aveugle.title: Blindfold play
aveugle.desc: Puzzles solved from memory: the position appears, disappears, then you play on an empty board.

notation.title: Notation
notation.desc: Read and write notation: play the announced move, a sequence of written moves, write a puzzle's solution.

reconstitution.title: Position recall
reconstitution.desc: A position appears for a few seconds then disappears: put all the pieces back from memory, from 3 pieces to the full position.

hints.spaced: Review mistakes along a forgetting curve.
hints.themes: No theme: all themes. Otherwise, a puzzle has at least one of the chosen themes.
hints.topic: If time runs out during a streak, you can extend it by 5 minutes.
hints.lightSet: The run starts again from the beginning of the set; it grows on its own when you've almost run through it.
hints.repertoires: Due reviews come first (automatic spaced repetition).
hints.evaluationDuration: A run lasts 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes: positions follow one another until the end.
hints.rushDuration: A rush lasts 2, 3 or 5 minutes: puzzles follow one another without a break, harder and harder.
hints.brilliancyDuration: A run lasts 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes: the moves to judge follow one another until the end.
